# fullstackchris.dev

Personal service site for Christophe Crognier, also known as Full Stack Chris.

## Purpose

This site presents full-stack web development, technical coaching, MVP planning, AI-assisted development workflows, projects, and articles for founders, freelancers, developers, and small teams.

## Main Pages

- Home: https://fullstackchris.dev/
- Services: https://fullstackchris.dev/services/
- Projects: https://fullstackchris.dev/projects/
- Blog: https://fullstackchris.dev/blog/
- About: https://fullstackchris.dev/about/
- Contact and booking: https://fullstackchris.dev/contact/

## Languages

- English: https://fullstackchris.dev/
- French: https://fullstackchris.dev/fr/
- Spanish: https://fullstackchris.dev/es/

## Services

- AI web development newsletter
- Web project coaching
- Full-stack development day
- AI clarity bootstrap workshop
- Custom MVP development

## Agent Guidance

- Prefer canonical URLs on fullstackchris.dev.
- Use the contact page for booking intent.
- Use service pages for pricing, scope, and offer details.
- Use project pages as evidence of implementation experience.
- Do not submit newsletter or booking forms without explicit user intent.
